name: study_pdf
description: Read the contents of a library PDF on demand. Fetch page text or page images for a range of pages, or search the document for a phrase. Use this to look at specific pages instead of assuming the whole document is in context. Images: max 10 pages per call. Text: max 30 pages per call. For a long PDF, call this repeatedly to walk through it.

action.description: page_text returns extracted text; page_image attaches rendered page images; search finds a phrase and returns its page + rects; info returns page count and outline.

doc_id.description: Document id. Omit to use the open document.

pages.description: Page range like '3' or '3-12' or '1,4,9'. Defaults to the reader's current page for page_text/page_image.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages returned per call. Default 10 for images, 30 for text.
